toolchain_receipt.note: The generator+toolchain half of the roadmap P0.1 'one receipt'. These are the versions the committed generated_lean_sha256 and raw_generated_sha256 pins were produced under; a bump invalidates the pins and requires a fresh complete-output `make verify-extraction-regen`, reviewed raw-pin update, and `check_extraction_freshness.py --update` for committed/source pins. A per-run command/timestamp/host receipt is intentionally not committed.
